Definition: Initials of the data extractor, first name and last name initials.
Category definitions: AA, BB, etc.: Initials of the data extractor, first name and last name initials.

Definition: Identifier of the included synthesis, usually first author and year. Use the recorded identifier for joins; do not infer publication year from it.
Category definitions: e.g., smith_2020: Unique ID of the review: firstauthor_year format

Definition: DOI of the included synthesis, as recorded. A URL or placeholder can occur when a DOI is unavailable; trim whitespace when matching.
Category definitions: e.g., 10.1093/beheco/ar: Digital Object Identifier (e.g., 10.1093/beheco/ar). Matched from journal metadata

Definition: Publication year in this dataset.
Category definitions: YYYY: Year of publication extracted from journal metadata

Definition: Systematic review: Structured evidence synthesis using a search strategy (keywords + databases), predefined criteria to identify and analyze studies, which often answer a question or make a recommendation about what they are reviewing.; Systematic map: Provides a structured overview of existing evidence to identify research clusters, gaps, and trends without quantitative synthesis; Meta-analysis: Statistical combination of effect sizes from multiple studies using statistical techniques to estimate overall trends and variation
Category definitions: Systematic review: Structured evidence synthesis using a search strategy (keywords + databases), predefined criteria to identify and analyze studies, which often answer a question or make a recommendation about what they are reviewing. | Systematic map: Provides a structured overview of existing evidence to identify research clusters, gaps, and trends without quantitative synthesis | Meta-analysis: Statistical combination of effect sizes from multiple studies using statistical techniques to estimate overall trends and variation

Definition: Whether the synthesis includes a quantitative approach; this does not necessarily mean it reports a pooled meta-analytic effect.
Category definitions: yes/no: Yes the synthesis has any kind of quantitative approach

Definition: Original extraction flag for CEESAT assessment. This is not the analysis inclusion filter: Datasets 4 and 5 contain all 50 appraisals.
Category definitions: yes/no: Yes if the synthesis was assessed with CEESAT

Definition: Whether the synthesis received policy citations.

Experimental: Includes manipulations with controlled conditions; Observational: Observes variables in natural settings without manipulation; Mixed: Includes both experimental and observational studies; Other: Includes theory or modelling, not empirical studies; Unclear: No information reported on study design
Category definitions: Experimental: Includes manipulations with controlled conditions | Observational: Observes variables in natural settings without manipulation | Mixed: Includes both experimental and observational studies | Other: Includes theory or modelling, not empirical studies | Unclear: No information reported on study design

Definition: Number of primary studies concerning noise reported by the synthesis; preserve qualified or nonnumeric entries.
Category definitions: interger: The number of noise-primary studies synthesized. Most be explicitly stated

Definition: Terrestrial: Land-based ecosystems, excluding urban areas, but can include rural and natural area.s; Freshwater: Lakes, rivers, wetlands, estuaries; Marine: Saltwater environments like the ocean; Urban: Human-dominated environments, cities, or industrial zones; Other: Ecosystems that don’t fit above (e.g., caves, polar); Unclear: Ecosystem type is not explicitly mentioned

Definition: Infrasonic: Below 20 Hz; Audible: Between 20 Hz and 20 kHz; Ultrasonic: Above 20 kHz; Mixed: Covers more than one range; Other: Unclassified or ambiguous range; Unclear: Not specified in the review
Category definitions: Infrasonic: Below 20 Hz | Audible: Between 20 Hz and 20 kHz | Ultrasonic: Above 20 kHz | Mixed: Covers more than one range | Other: Unclassified or ambiguous range | Unclear: Not specified in the review

Definition: Details supporting the recorded outcome categories.
Extracted direction-of-effect notes; not a complete effect-size dataset and not used to estimate pooled effects.
